_comment: The canonical Oath standard library: a reviewed, versioned mapping from
project names under oath/* to immutable artifacts.
JSON rather than YAML deliberately. The Go kernel is zero-dependency in its
default build, and a manifest the kernel may one day need to read must not
require a parser it cannot have. PR diffs review identically.
THE ARTIFACT HASHES HERE ARE ASSERTIONS AND ARE NOT TRUSTED. CI recomputes
each one from the canonical object and fails if it disagrees; a manifest that
could assert a hash without reproducing it would let a review approve one
Membership is governed by pull request. Authority over oath/* is governed by
the project key. Neither substitutes for the other.
authority_note: The project key that must hold oath/* and sign every publication under it. PUBLIC HALF ONLY — the private key is never in this repository. TEMPORARY LIMITATION: this version has no delegation, so this same key must both hold the namespace and perform CI publication. A compromised release secret would therefore control the namespace itself, not merely the right to publish into it. The intended end state is an offline authority key delegating publication to a revocable release key; until delegation exists this is recorded rather than hidden.
